title: Course media

# Course media

Course videos upload directly to object storage and encode asynchronously.

## Publish flow

1. `POST /api/stream/upload-url` with the course id, title, file name, MIME type
   and size.
2. PUT the source bytes to the returned URL.
3. `POST /api/stream/upload-complete` with `{ videoId }`.
4. Poll `GET /api/stream/status/{videoId}`.
5. Play from `GET /api/stream/videos/{videoId}`.

## States

`queued` → `encoding` → `completed` or `failed`.

A queued video is not an error. Encoding is asynchronous and may wait behind
other videos. Do not publish a failed or partial encode.

## Limits

- Direct upload: 2 GB per source.
- R2 must be configured for large sources.
- R2 CORS must allow PUT from the instructor origin.
